<thought>From the observed isotopic pattern—a dominant M peak with progressively smaller M+1, M+2, M+3 peaks typical of many 13C contributions—and the absence of the characteristic 3:1 (Cl) or 1:1 (Br) M+2 patterns, the only element that can be definitively identified is carbon.</thought>
<final_answer>['C']</final_answer>
